encoding: uint16 little-endian, row-major 256x256 per frame, value = min + code/65535*(max-min); frame i starts at byte offset i*131072

provenance.engine: .asset-engine-v3 (unmodified copies of the simulator OPC and optical engine)
provenance.note: New 5-iteration run (record-opc-dense.cjs) on the hero DENSE_LS target: four 150 x 900 nm lines at x = 100/350/600/850, y = 100. Request 0 is the segmented but uncorrected target (36 rects union to the four lines). Recomputed contours matched the recording exactly.
provenance.downsampling: intensity simulated at 512x512 (2.1484 nm/px) then 2x2 box-averaged to 256x256; contours and EPE are the 512-grid results
